# Apdigi Activations

## Project
- Static four-page website built with semantic HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.
- Pages: `index.html`, `about.html`, `services.html`, and `contact.html`.
- Shared styling and interaction scripts are in `assets/`.
- No build tools or package installation are required.

## Working Guidelines
- Preserve the black, charcoal, white, and yellow visual identity.
- Keep navigation, contact details, form behavior, and responsive layouts consistent across pages.
- The contact form is client-side only. Do not state that it sends enquiries until a backend or email service is configured.

## Setup Checklist
- [x] Workspace instructions created and verified.
- [x] Requirements clarified: static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript site.
- [x] Four pages and shared assets created.
- [x] No additional extensions or packages required.
- [x] Page navigation, responsive menu, image loading, and form validation checked.
- [x] VS Code task not required for this static site.
- [x] No development server required; open `index.html` in a browser.
- [x] `README.md` documents local use and form configuration.
